defect: The fix makes the analog limiter use the existing fAnalogLimiterDeadzone setting instead of a hard-coded deadzone constant.
reason: The setting was already ignored before this change (hard-coded 0.15f); this change only raised the constant to 0.20f.

defect: The fix makes GetMemoryBlockPtr take an output address and write the block pointer there, and honours the type argument in AllocMemoryBlock.
reason: Returning the uid and allocating with fromTop=false was the behaviour before this change, which only converted the functions to wrappers.

defect: The fix moves menu enable/disable into UpdateCommands so accelerator keys get the right enabled state outside WM_MENUSELECT.
reason: The stale hotkey state comes from UpdateMenus being called only when a menu drops down, not from the quick save/load items this change added.

defect: The new loop sets bootpath to EBOOT.OLD whichever alternate boot file exists, and the new PAKFILE2.BIN entry points to SYSDIR instead of USRDIR.
reason: Both lines were added by this change and the fix corrects exactly them (bootpath = altBootNames[i], USRDIR path).

defect: In this file the fix only adds a comment to GetCurrentBackendState; the wrong assert it fixes lives in EmuScreen.cpp.
reason: The added GetCurrentBackendState returns correct values and nothing in this file's change is repaired.

defect: The fix masks arg with 0x0FFFFFFF before computing the address in the 0x3 increment/decrement cheat code.
reason: The unmasked getAddress(arg) existed before; this change only renamed it to GetAddress.

defect: The fix replaces the read of the uninitialized w in the OK-button width computation with a constant.
reason: w was already read uninitialized before this change, which only changed the added constant from 12 to 16.

defect: The fix changes int loop counters compared with the u32 size to u32 to silence sign-comparison warnings.
reason: size is capped at 10 MB, so the signed/unsigned comparison is harmless; this is a warning cleanup, not a defect.

defect: The fix changes curAddress, windowStart and getSelection to u32 to silence sign-comparison warnings.
reason: The comparisons already promote windowStart to unsigned and give the same result, so behaviour is unchanged.

defect: In FlushAll the static check for the second register of a pair tests mr[i].isStatic instead of mr[i + 1].isStatic, so a static register holding a pure imm can be stored via SCRATCH2 and then discarded.
reason: The copy-paste error is on a line this change added, and the fix corrects it (and marks static imms as ARMREG_IMM after the now ML_IMM-based SetImm).

defect: The fix replaces nulling currentRenderVfb_ in ReadFramebufferToMemory with RebindFramebuffer so copy-to-output can reuse the last render target.
reason: currentRenderVfb_ was already nulled in this function before the change, which only moved the assignment; the artifact came from CopyDisplayToOutputInternal.

defect: CopyDisplayToOutputInternal now calls SetRenderFrameBuffer, which picks a framebuffer from the current gstate instead of rebinding the last render target, causing the Jeanne d'Arc world map artifact.
reason: The fix, by the same author 26 minutes later, replaces exactly this added call with RebindFramebuffer; seeing it needs SetRenderFrameBuffer's semantics.

defect: SUB(Rd, Ra, Rb) emits SUBF(Rd, Ra, Rb), which computes Rb - Ra, so the operands are reversed.
reason: The new helper is the line the fix corrects by swapping the operands.

defect: CompITypeMemRead/Write pass a fixed size of 4 to PrepareRead/PrepareWrite, so memchecks for byte and halfword accesses test a 4-byte range and trip falsely.
reason: The size argument was added by this change and the fix replaces it with bits / 8.

defect: The fix moves the m_pFrame/m_pFrameRGB null check before the m_pFrameRGB->linesize write in stepVideo.
reason: In this change the null check precedes every use; the dereference before it was added later by 8dfeeee.

defect: In this file the fix only removes a redundant if around maxLevelToGenerate and edits a comment; the menu fix is in other files.
reason: The simplification does not change behaviour, so no defect of this change is repaired.

defect: The fix fills ctime/atime/mtime of savedata list entries with real dates instead of zeros.
reason: The dates were already written as zero (TODO) before this change; the fix adds the missing feature.

defect: Comp_VDot uses DestRegOverlaps, which now allows dregs[0] == sregs[0], and then maps dregs with MAP_NOINIT so the source value is not loaded; the final MOVSS also copies XMM0 instead of tempxreg.
reason: The overlap allowance and VDot rewrite come from this change, and the fix adds IsOverlapSafe to forbid that case and stores tempxreg.

defect: The fix zero-initializes the value buffer in LoadNocashSym.
reason: value is only read after sscanf returned 2 and filled it, so no uninitialized read occurs; the fix is defensive.

defect: ResolveSyscall patches the import stub with JAL instead of J, so the callee returns into the stub instead of to the original caller.
reason: The JAL line was added by this change and the fix replaces it with J.

defect: The new 5551 alpha multiplier 1/128 maps a 1-bit alpha index to palette entry 2 instead of 1 in the 256-wide CLUT texture.
reason: The fix corrects this multiplier, introduced by this change, to 1/256 (the wrong 5551 shift labels it also fixes predate the change).

defect: ApplyTexture computes the new hash into a local fullhash that is never stored, so entry->fullhash is no longer updated after this change removed the assignment from SetTexture.
reason: The fix assigns the hash to entry->fullhash on the line this change added.

defect: hleLagSync uses scale = iFpsLimit / 60 instead of 60 / iFpsLimit, so a faster alternate speed makes each sync wait longer.
reason: The inverted ratio is on a line added by this change and the fix swaps it.

defect: NID 0x28235C56 is registered as sceAudioRoutingSetVolumeMode taking an argument, but it is sceAudioRoutingGetVolumeMode, so a game's get call overwrites the mode with garbage.
reason: The wrong NID mapping was added by this change and the fix remaps it; spotting it needs the PSP NID table, not the code.

defect: The fix corrects the '&08x' typo in a warning format string.
reason: The typo predates this change, which only fixed the field name, and it only affects log text.

defect: The fix passes the index count as DrawIndexed's count and 1 as the instance count in the indexed UP draws.
reason: The misordered (0, type, count) arguments existed before; this change only removed the index format parameter.

defect: In this file the fix renames sizeTwips, adds SimulateGamepad and a windowed mode for desktop; it repairs nothing from this change.
reason: The missing return in CalculateDPIScale on non-Symbian builds was fixed by an earlier commit, not by this fix.

defect: The fix always appends .zip to the store file name, fixing names that contain a dot.
reason: The dot check was moved unchanged from OnInstall into DownloadURL; it predates this change.

defect: The fix renames the ini key to ReportingHost so values wrongly saved by the settings UI are reset.
reason: The bug is the settings screen treating 'default' as enabled, not the load/save lines added here.

defect: The fix makes the settings screen treat 'default' as reports disabled and save 'default' when unchecked.
reason: The same enableReports_/sReportHost logic existed in GlobalSettingsScreen before; this change only moved it.

defect: PointerWrap is forward-declared as struct while it is defined as a class, which breaks the MSVC build (different name mangling).
reason: The forward declaration was added by this change and the fix makes it class; seeing it needs PointerWrap's definition.

defect: The fix rebinds the render framebuffer after the debugger's depth, stencil and output copies and drops buffer.Free on a failed stencil copy.
reason: The missing rebind after these copies predates this change, and buffer.Free only nulls the data and does not crash.

defect: ClearBuffer calls glClearDepth, which does not exist in OpenGL ES 2, breaking the GLES builds.
reason: The call was added by this change and the fix replaces it with glClearDepthf.

defect: The fix strips line breaks from the save title before using it as the popup title.
reason: The raw title was already passed to the popup before this change.

defect: ~VKContext deletes the VulkanDeviceAllocator immediately although textures freed earlier have queued deletions that still use it, a use-after-free on shutdown.
reason: The immediate delete was added by this change and the fix defers it through the delete queue; seeing it needs the allocator's deferred frees.

defect: The fix moves right stick binding out of DinputDevice::UpdateState as part of reworking DirectInput into key events.
reason: It is a feature rework of code later extended by other commits, not a repair of a defect in these lines.

defect: The fix removes the unused prevState member.
reason: Removing an unused member is a cleanup, not a defect fix.

defect: The threaded load has no lifetime coordination: LimitedWaitable::Wait/WaitFor use the inverted predicate !triggered_ and never wait, and IsReady deletes the waitable while the task may still be in Notify or the texture may be destroyed under the task.
reason: The fix removes this change's WaitAndRelease calls from IsReady and adds a mutex so destruction waits for the loading task.

defect: sceKernelCancelWakeupThread writes 'uid == __KernelGetCurThread()' (a comparison) instead of an assignment, so uid 0 is never resolved to the current thread.
reason: The fix turns the added comparison into an assignment.

defect: The fix drops the Android 'assets/shaders' path, a workaround made unnecessary by a later bug fix.
reason: Android already used assets/shaders before this change, and the fix message says the workaround was needed until then.
